records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Silver Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for setting up Silver Analytics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 2 (2026-06-21), so Sam is active, and a getting started call was held [calendar:42320cad]. But no reply to either outreach [email:b3500a89, email:f73333ca], no invite sent in 6 days, and key milestone depends on shared/teammate work, leaving 8 days. Moderate-low chance unaided.

draft.subject: Next step for Silver Analytics
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the getting started call last week — good to see your first project up and running in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step that usually makes the difference is getting your team in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
